sources.label: Wikipedia, "WASP-13b"
sources.quote: WASP-13b, also known as Cruinlagh, is an extrasolar planet that was discovered in 2008 in the orbit of the sunlike star WASP-13.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around Gloas. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "WASP-13b"
sources.quote: The planet has a mass of nearly half that of Jupiter, but a radius five-quarters of the size of Jupiter.
